negative.meaning: direction flag returned by Elo.ratingChange; true means eloB should decrease
negative.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elo_b_delta.meaning: signed change applied to eloB's rating by battleElo (positive means increase)
elo_b_delta.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative

elo_a_delta.meaning: signed change applied to eloA's rating by battleElo (positive means increase)
elo_a_delta.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative

better_party_rating_decreased.meaning: the party that performed better or won saw its rating decrease
better_party_rating_decreased.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative

worse_party_rating_increased.meaning: the party that performed worse or lost saw its rating increase
worse_party_rating_increased.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative

assumptions: The rating change and direction flag are derived from a series of battle results passed to battleElo.
The better-performing party's rating must not decrease and the worse-performing party's rating must not increase under the reported direction semantics.

unresolved.description: Report does not fix whether the better/worse party maps to eloA or eloB, so the correspondence between party outcome and the eloA/eloB delta symbols is not pinned to a specific party.
Report gives no concrete prior rating values or numeric change amount; deltas are symbolic.

limitations: Formalizes only the winner_rating_decreases_loser_increases impact; downstream dependent-protocol harms are not covered by this plan.
The negative=false branch of the intent is not encoded as a separate condition; only the negative=true scenario is formalized here.
Party-to-eloA/eloB mapping is left symbolic per report ambiguity.
